wiki.title: Michael Aylesworth
wiki.extract: Michael Jerome Aylesworth (born March 24, 1943) is an American politician who is a current member of the Indiana House of Representatives. A member of the Republican Party, Aylesworth was elected to the Indiana House on November 4, 2014, and was subsequently sworn in on November 19 of that year. Elected to represent the 11th district, Aylesworth's district represents southern Lake and Porter County.
